children: Overview
UK contract proteomics provider's H1 2026 revenue was flat yr/yr at £1.87 mln
Proteomics services revenue fell due to timing, while TMT sales and royalties increased
Gross profit rose and net loss narrowed as costs declined
Outlook
Proteome Sciences expects full-year 2026 services revenue to significantly increase over 2025
Company anticipates continued recovery in TMT® revenues in the second half of 2026
Company sees prospects for future revenue growth from new tags and evolving proteomics workflows
Result Drivers
SERVICES REVENUE TIMING - Co said lower H1 proteomics services revenue was due to timing issues, with expectations for higher volumes in H2
TMT SALES RECOVERY - Co said TMT reagent sales and royalties rose 24% in H1, reflecting recovery in US grant funding and market demand
COST REDUCTION - Co attributed lower operating loss to an 11% reduction in cost of sales and administrative expenses
